messages:
tess: Quick sync  we're cutting the benchmark post + webinar landing next Tue. Need a concise SEO checklist: primary keywords, schema for benchmark results, internal anchor plan, and redirects for legacy blog slugs. Who's on?

kai: I can do keywords + anchors. Proposal: benchmark page primary = "LLM inference latency vs cost"; secondaries = ["inference cost benchmarks", "GPU latency comparisons"]. Anchor priorities: hero -> 'Benchmark overview', results table -> 'Detailed results', CTA -> 'Register for webinar'.

nora: I'll own schema + redirects. For schema: Dataset + SoftwareApplication for harness metadata, and HowTo/Result for methodology highlights. Small JSON-LD example I'll drop in the doc. Redirects: push 302 on first deploy for monitoring, then flip to 301 after 6 hours. Edge rules at Fastly.

seo-bot: Staging scan: https://ci.reports/scan/1749994321 - flags: OG image missing on webinar page, 2 internal anchors not found, canonical tag present but duplicates tag pages.

tess: @nora please fix OG + canonical dedupe. @kai check anchors vs DOM ids. Also we need HubSpot form mapping: campaign and lead_source props.

engops: HubSpot test webhook hooked to staging pipeline 'marketing-webinar'. Form GUID hs_444yyy. Ensure hidden field campaign=webinar_may24.

kai: Found one anchor mismatch: id was `results-table` but link used `results_table`. I'll patch both the template and CMS block.

nora: Pushed schema snippet to the draft branch and added redirect rules in the sheet. Example _redirects line for Netlify: `/old-blog-slug /benchmarks/latency-cost-2024 302`

tess: Great. Final runbook for tomorrow: 1) validate rich results, 2) smoke CDN redirects in staging, 3) run HubSpot webhook test, 4) final meta/title QA. If green, publish Tue 11:00 PT. :rocket:
